_comment: Al-Fatihah quizzes, taught before tested (operator 2026-10-10, narration rule 16: "make sure all questions in quiz already have lesson beforehand when exploring ayat"; the quiz audit and the main session's decisions of 2026-10-11: 2–3 exercises per ayah, about four questions each; wrong options only from ayat already studied and differing in cause; no question with two correct options; sort-case bins = the case states taught so far, none while only one is known). REPLANNED ON THE BASIC CURRICULUM (main session, 2026-10-13; kurikulum-dasar.md decision 7: "No lesson line may use a term before the lesson that teaches it"): a question, its options and its explanation use only terms taught by its lesson, so ayah 1 keeps tap-word alone — no wrong option of why-harakat is taught by then (idhafah comes in ayah 4, na't in ayah 3; the isim / fi'il / huruf warm-up that will stand there is a later task) — ayah 2 asks the roles its lesson taught (mubtada', khabar) and ayat 6 and 7 the ones theirs did. No wazan exercise: all sharaf is tingkat lanjut (decision 6), and quiz.BASIC_EXERCISES leaves wazn-factory out. Left out as before: ma'thuf, and badal while it is untaught (An-Nas 2), so the words whose role or reason is badal are no label-role question and their explanation says "pengganti" (their `why_basic` in al-fatihah.words.json). Per ayah, per exercise: tap-word {words}, why-harakat [{word, distractors: the words whose reason is a wrong option}], sort-case {words, bins}, label-role [{word, distractors: the words whose role is a wrong option}]. Words by their number in the ayah; distractors by loc. build_quiz.py resolves it into content/quiz/al-fatihah.json; validate_quiz.py checks it, including that every term a question needs was taught by the narration first.
